string-array.name: changelog_097
string-array.item: Fixed full-player edge coverage and improved Now Playing readability.
Improved Home collage and notification artwork quality.
Fixed saved AI keys being misreported as missing and clarified where AI is used.

string-array.name: changelog_096
string-array.item: Added real microphone song recognition using local Chromaprint fingerprints and AcoustID.
Recognition results now search and play inside VYBE instead of opening Google.
Kept Spotify authentication inside VYBE and refined the Recently Played layout.

string-array.name: changelog_094_added
string-array.item: Added configurable song-recognition visibility, Bluetooth audio controls, custom update reminders, and developer support links.

string-array.name: changelog_094_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed exact album and artist navigation, multi-artist selection, and persistent Library tab order and visibility.
Restored square Home artwork cards and added clear up-to-date feedback.

string-array.name: changelog_093_added
string-array.item: Added Release Radar, Top Charts, Listen Again, related recommendations, Fresh Finds, and song recognition.
Added data saver, high-refresh UI controls, animated artwork, and promoted Now Playing support.

string-array.name: changelog_093_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed AI provider matching and expanded update size, progress, and reminder information.
Standardized the VYBE notification icon across app notifications.

string-array.name: changelog_091_added
string-array.item: Added complete Quick Picks long-press actions for likes, downloads, queue, playlists, sharing, albums, and artists.
Added an apply-now or restart-later prompt when changing the VYBE logo mode.

string-array.name: changelog_091_improvements
string-array.item: Refined the About, Home, splash, profile, and connected YouTube Music account presentation.
Light and dark system splash screens now use the correct contrasting logo and background.

string-array.name: changelog_091_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed logo cropping, Home logo alignment, and excessive empty space in Profile & Statistics.
Fixed logo appearance changes not offering an immediate application restart.

string-array.name: changelog_087_added
string-array.item: Added selectable Light, Dark, and Dynamic VYBE logo modes.
Added temporary mood playlists with optional saving and customizable mood colors.
Added dedicated in-app bug report and feature suggestion forms.

string-array.name: changelog_087_improvements
string-array.item: Applied the new VYBE logo across onboarding, Home, About, launcher, and media surfaces.
Profile analytics now opens fully and focuses on listening statistics and habits.
Changelog and update actions now use a compact side-by-side layout.

string-array.name: changelog_087_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed Library shuffle for songs, liked tracks, albums, and artists.
Fixed valid albums opening as not found and removed single-track false albums.
Removed obsolete Cloud, Local, All Songs, and Backup & Restore entry points.

string-array.name: changelog_0722_added
string-array.item: Voice Assistant Integration: You can now ask Google Assistant or Bixby to play a song on VYBE directly!

string-array.name: changelog_0722_fixes
string-array.item: Missing Metadata Fix: Fixed an issue where tracks sometimes displayed "Online Track" instead of their real title.
Album Search Fix: Fixed an issue where searching for an album by name didn\'t show it correctly in the Albums tab.

string-array.name: changelog_0721_added
string-array.item: Search Enhancements: YouTube Music search results are now cleanly categorized, with a dedicated section and tab just for "Videos", separating them from standard songs.

string-array.name: changelog_0721_improvements
string-array.item: UI Architecture: Completely removed the experimental "Liquid Glass" App UI Style setting as it caused performance and layout issues. The app now strictly uses the polished Material UI.

string-array.name: changelog_0720_fixes
string-array.item: Library Crash Fix: Fixed a critical crash that occurred when switching between tabs (like Folders/Albums) in the Library after playing music, which was caused by duplicate unique IDs in the listening history grid.

string-array.name: changelog_0719_improvements
string-array.item: Onboarding Improvements: Made critical permissions (Media, Notifications, and Battery Optimization) strictly mandatory. Users can no longer skip these during the initial setup, preventing unexpected crashes later. Optional preferences (Theme, Backup, Layouts) remain skippable.

string-array.name: changelog_0719_fixes
string-array.item: Notification Fix: Fixed an issue where tapping the media notification in the status bar would unnecessarily trigger the player sheet to slide open. It now correctly returns you to your previous state in the app without unwanted actions.

string-array.name: changelog_0718_improvements
string-array.item: UI Enhancements: Upgraded the Playlist and Artist detail screens by replacing standard rectangular buttons with a sleek row of three floating action buttons (Play, Shuffle, Loop) shaped with RoundedStarShape.

string-array.name: changelog_0718_fixes
string-array.item: App Launch/Setup Crash: Fixed a critical race condition that caused the app to crash or freeze on many devices immediately after completing the onboarding setup. Navigation to the Home screen now safely waits for DataStore commits.

Release Stability: Added comprehensive ProGuard and R8 rules to prevent aggressive code stripping for Hilt, Room DAOs, ExoPlayer/Media3, and WorkManager, which caused invisible crashes on fresh installs.
Sync Safety: Wrapped initial library full sync in a safety block so that localized sync failures do not block app setup.

string-array.name: changelog_0717_added
string-array.item: Search History: Added a Search History UI that displays previous search queries when the search bar is empty.

string-array.name: changelog_0717_improvements
string-array.item: Branding Updates: Removed the old Beta clean-install disclaimer on startup. Replaced the Beta button in the top bar with "Smoothy Play" text.

string-array.name: changelog_0717_fixes
string-array.item: Queue Deletion Crash: Fixed a NumberFormatException crash when attempting to delete online songs from the queue by safely filtering non-local IDs.
Song Info Sheet: Online songs no longer display the "Delete from device" option, preventing unsupported actions.

string-array.name: changelog_0716_fixes
string-array.item: Keystore Crash Fix: Fixed crashes on devices with broken MasterKey/EncryptedSharedPreferences by safely falling back to standard SharedPreferences.

string-array.name: changelog_0712_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed the duplicate artist-history key crash.
Fixed square and landscape artwork presentation in the immersive player.
Restored original album metadata and track artwork.
Added automatic GitHub update alerts with reminder and skip controls.

string-array.name: changelog_0711_fixes
string-array.item: Artist pages now open immediately and progressively load original profiles, artwork, and full catalogues.
Added a Storage & cache dashboard with image cache, downloads, other app data, and total usage.
Added VYBE song links with direct in-app playback and a download fallback.
Fixed online song duration metadata and protected private online and offline file paths.
Improved update recovery for older databases and stale transient files.

string-array.name: changelog_0710_fixes
string-array.item: Prevented legacy or damaged local databases from trapping VYBE in a startup crash loop.
Added automatic recovery for corrupted app settings while preserving healthy user data.

string-array.name: changelog_079_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed an immediate startup crash affecting existing installations upgrading from database version 42.
Expanded database migration verification through the current release schema.

string-array.name: changelog_020_added
string-array.item: Chromecast support for casting audio from your device.
In-app changelog to keep you updated on the latest features.
Support for .LRC files, both embedded and external.
Offline lyrics support.
Synchronized lyrics (synced with the song).
New screen to view the full queue.
Reorder and remove songs from the queue.
Mini-player gestures (swipe down to close).
Added more material animations.
New settings to customize the look and feel.
New settings to clear the cache.

string-array.name: changelog_020_improvements
string-array.item: Complete redesign of the user interface.
Complete redesign of the player.
Performance improvements in the library.
Improved application startup speed.
The AI now provides better results.

string-array.name: changelog_020_fixes
string-array.item: Fixed various bugs in the tag editor.
Fixed a bug where the playback notification was not clearing.
Fixed several bugs that caused the app to crash.

string-array.name: changelog_030_whats_new
string-array.item: Introduced a richer listening stats hub with deeper insights into your sessions.
Launched a floating quick player to instantly open and preview local files.
Added a folders tab with a tree-style navigator and playlist-ready view.

string-array.name: changelog_030_improvements
string-array.item: Refined the overall Material 3 UI for a cleaner and more cohesive experience.
Metadata editing now supports cover art change.
Smoothed out animations and transitions across the app for more fluid navigation.
Enhanced the artist screen layout with richer details and polish.
Upgraded DailyMix and YourMix generation with smarter, more diverse selections.
Strengthened the AI playlist generation.
Improved search relevance and presentation for faster discovery.
Expanded support for a broader range of audio file formats.

string-array.name: changelog_030_fixes
string-array.item: Resolved metadata quirks so song details stay accurate everywhere.
Restored notification shortcuts so they reliably jump back into playback.

string-array.name: changelog_040_improvements
string-array.item: Major navigation redesign
New file explorer for choosing source directories
New Connectivity and casting functionalities
Seamless continuity between remote devices
Gapless transition between songs
Crossfade control
New Custom Transitions feature (only for playlists)
Keep playing after closed the app
UI Optimizations
Improved stats feature
Redesigned Queue control with more features
Improved different filetypes support for playing and metadata editing
Improved permission controller
Minor bug fixes

string-array.name: changelog_050_improvements
string-array.item: Material 3 Expressive UI Update
10-band Equalizer & Effects
New Library Sync Flow
AI Integration (Gemini Models)
M3U Playlist Import/Export
Deezer Artist Artwork Integration
Custom Playlist Covers
Settings Architecture Refactor
Queue & Player Animations
Baseline Profiles & Performance
Better Lyrics System with Sync Offset

string-array.name: changelog_050_fixes
string-array.item: Casting Stability Improvements
Player Sheet Stability
General Bug Fixes & Cleanup

string-array.name: changelog_060_whats_new
string-array.item: Android Auto support is now available for in-car playback.
Wear OS support is live, including better watch-to-phone playback controls.
Cloud integrations expanded with Telegram, NetEase, QQ Music, and Google Drive improvements.
Recently Played and persistent queue restoration keep your listening session ready.
Backup & Restore v3 and account management tools are now included.
Lyrics got smarter with manual search fallback and storage improvements.

string-array.name: changelog_060_improvements
string-array.item: Big performance pass across startup, library, queue, and player interactions.
Player, Cast, Lyrics, Artist, and Genre surfaces were redesigned for smoother use.
Navigation and search flows are more reliable, with safer route handling.
Audio playback compatibility improved for more devices and formats.
Multi-selection workflows were expanded across songs, albums, and playlists.

string-array.name: changelog_060_fixes
string-array.item: Queue and shuffle behavior is now more stable and predictable.
Several background playback and casting edge cases were fixed.
Sleep Timer, Files tab navigation, and album artist crash issues were fixed.
Widget loading and service stability were improved to reduce overheating/memory issues.
General bug fixes and UI polish across the app.

string-array.name: changelog_070_whats_new
string-array.item: Wear OS: Music transfer, local playback, queue sync, and remote control from watch.
AI: Groq AI and OpenRouter (experimental) integration with token optimization.
Cloud: Jellyfin support added.
Lyrics: Synced translation with dedicated toggle, Kugou LRC format support, text alignment customization, and improved remote loading.
UI/UX: Compact navigation bar mode, dynamic themes from album art palette, marquee for long titles, and new sorting options.
Telegram: Native topics support and enhanced display modes.

string-array.name: changelog_070_improvements
string-array.item: Audio Engine: Complete overhaul with support for more formats (MIDI, ALAC, M4A) and decoder optimization.
Efficiency: Drastic energy consumption reduction, overheating fixes, and background task optimization (SyncWorker).
Database: Massive query optimizations and redesigned cover art cache to prevent data loss.
Startup: Improved loading time via Baseline Profile optimization.

string-array.name: changelog_070_fixes
string-array.item: Playback: Fixed stuttering in Opus/MP3, ReplayGain errors during crossfades, and startup issues on Samsung decoders.
Stability: Eliminated crashes on startup, artist navigation, and Android 12+ devices.
UI: Fixed cover art flickering, text overflow in non-Latin scripts, and navigation bar/miniplayer behavior.
Security: Hardened credential handling, storage permissions, and media server communication.

string-array.name: changelog_070_added
string-array.item: Localization: Spanish, French, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, Italian

string-array.name: changelog_075_whats_new
string-array.item: Google Drive integration with player lifecycle management.
Batch song metadata editing (tags and cover art).
AI lyrics translation with customizable Wear OS preferences.
Lag diagnostic tool and multi-selection on Search screen.
Arabic & Turkish support, with localized http URL local-network options.

string-array.name: changelog_075_improvements
string-array.item: Drastic battery saving (audio offload and UI polling gates).
Optimized queue management (faster insertions and explicit indexing).
Material 3 Expressive motion animations for transition screens.
Refactored library synchronization via throttled scanning.

string-array.name: changelog_075_fixes
string-array.item: Resolved stuttering/skipping playback lags and buffering issues.
Fixed external song deletion sync and metadata consistency.
Fixed memory issues, crashes, and layout glitches on Wear OS and phone.

string-array.name: changelog_0715_fixes
string-array.item: Completely abandoned broken hardware Keystore on specific devices, eliminating startup crashes.
Fixed Immersive Artwork layout where title/artist text was invisible over bright covers.

string-array.name: changelog_0715_added
string-array.item: Added Play, Shuffle, and Loop playback buttons directly to Album, Playlist, and Artist profile headers.

string-array.name: changelog_0715_improvements
string-array.item: Updated underlying security architecture.

string-array.name: changelog_0714_fixes
string-array.item: Attempted to fix AEADBadTagException startup crash on some Android 13/14 devices.

string-array.name: changelog_0713_fixes

string-array.name: changelog_0713_improvements
